limitations: Source and inputs match within their specified scope. Concurrent workload counts differ and are not phase-separated.
The 1000/200 unprobed baseline uses a 120 s diagnostic deadline. Original deadline is 30 s.
Without probes, total SQLite API calls and general Store/executor lock waits are unmeasured. Context-row lock metrics cover only that writer.
The overload fixture does not qualify historical evidence. Collector counts and native SQL counts are reported separately.
Cold startup metrics cover measured Store components, not total boot. No independent active worker occupancy time series.
Synthetic host only. Distinct trial identities are fixture assumptions. No Pi, real HA, Recorder, or device acceptance.
